name: Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Summon an Fire Elemental
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): summon an Fire Elemental, as if by Conjure Elemental; it obeys you while you concentrate, up to an hour.

summary: Once a day, summon an Fire Elemental that obeys you (Concentration, up to 1 hour).
text: While you are holding this brazier, you can take a Magic action to summon an Fire Elemental. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the brazier as possible, is friendly to you and your companions, and obeys your commands. It lasts as long as you maintain Concentration (as if concentrating on a spell), up to 1 hour. The brazier can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
